current sheet ('#9,#10, small eps') of the Calc workbook."""

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Cm
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_TAB_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn, nsmap
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement


SRC = '/home/user/Desktop/OSP_Envelope_Price-List_2023_5000.xlsx'
OUT = '/home/user/Desktop/price.docx'
SHEET = '#9,#10, small eps'

# --- Read source workbook ----------------------------------------------------
wb = load_workbook(SRC, data_only=False)
ws = wb[SHEET]


def fmt_qty(v):
    if v is None:
        return ''
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return f"{int(v):,}"
    return str(v)


def fmt_money(v):
    if v is None:
        return ''
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return f"$ {int(round(v)):,}"
    return str(v)


# Compute formula values manually (workbook formulas may not have cached values)
def compute_row(qty):
    return (
        round(qty * 0.0394 + 420),
        round(qty * 0.045  + 420),
        round(qty * 0.0406 + 420),
        round(qty * 0.0488 + 420),
    )


# Build display matrix for rows 1..15, columns A..E
# Row 1: headers
headers = [ws.cell(row=1, column=c).value or '' for c in range(1, 6)]

# Rows 2..14: quantity rows
qty_rows = []
for r in range(2, 15):
    qty = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    b, c, d, e = compute_row(qty)
    qty_rows.append((qty, b, c, d, e))

# Row 15: Estimate No. row
estimate = [ws.cell(row=15, column=c).value for c in range(1, 6)]

# --- Build the docx ----------------------------------------------------------
doc = Document()

# A bit narrower margins so the table is comfortable on the page
for section in doc.sections:
    section.left_margin = Cm(2)
    section.right_margin = Cm(2)
    section.top_margin = Cm(2)
    section.bottom_margin = Cm(2)

# Title
title = doc.add_paragraph()
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
trun = title.add_run(SHEET)
trun.bold = True
trun.font.name = 'Arial'
trun.font.size = Pt(12)

# Total rows: 1 header + 13 qty rows + 1 estimate = 15
total_rows = 15
total_cols = 5
table = doc.add_table(rows=total_rows, cols=total_cols)
table.style = 'Table Grid'  # gives every cell a thin border like Calc gridlines

GRAY = 'D9D9D9'


def set_cell_shading(cell, hex_color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement('w:shd')
    shd.set(qn('w:val'), 'clear')
    shd.set(qn('w:color'), 'auto')
    shd.set(qn('w:fill'), hex_color)
    tcPr.append(shd)


def set_cell_vertical_alignment(cell, val):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    vAlign = OxmlElement('w:vAlign')
    vAlign.set(qn('w:val'), val)  # 'top' / 'center' / 'bottom'
    tcPr.append(vAlign)


def write_cell(cell, text, *, font_size_pt=10, bold=False,
               align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT, money=False):
    """Write text into a table cell with desired font + alignment.
    For money cells, lay out a left-aligned `$` and a right-aligned number,
    so it visually matches Calc's accounting format."""
    cell.text = ''  # clear default empty paragraph
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]

    if money and text:
        # text expected as "$ 1,234" — split symbol and number
        parts = text.split(' ', 1)
        symbol = parts[0]
        number = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        # tab stop near the right edge of the cell so the number lines up right
        tab_stops = p.paragraph_format.tab_stops
        tab_stops.add_tab_stop(Cm(2.6), WD_TAB_ALIGNMENT.RIGHT)
        run1 = p.add_run(symbol)
        run1.font.name = 'Arial'
        run1.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)
        run1.bold = bold
        # tab + number
        run2 = p.add_run('\t' + number)
        run2.font.name = 'Arial'
        run2.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)
        run2.bold = bold
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT
    else:
        run = p.add_run(text)
        run.font.name = 'Arial'
        run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)
        run.bold = bold
        p.alignment = align

    set_cell_vertical_alignment(cell, 'center')


# --- Header row (row 1) ------------------------------------------------------
hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
# A1 is empty in source; B1..E1 are MCC IDs, all centered, 9pt
for col_idx, val in enumerate(headers):
    write_cell(
        hdr_cells[col_idx],
        str(val) if val is not None else '',
        font_size_pt=9,
        bold=True,
        align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER,
    )

# --- Quantity rows (rows 2..14) ---------------------------------------------
# Rows 3,5,7,9,11,13 (1-indexed in xlsx) are gray. In our table, header is row 0,
# so xlsx row r becomes table row r-1. The gray rows are odd r in 3..13.
gray_xlsx_rows = {3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13}

for offset, (qty, b, c, d, e) in enumerate(qty_rows):
    xlsx_row = 2 + offset      # 2..14
    table_row_idx = 1 + offset  # 1..13
    row = table.rows[table_row_idx]
    is_gray = xlsx_row in gray_xlsx_rows

    # column A — quantity, right aligned with thousands sep
    write_cell(
        row.cells[0], fmt_qty(qty),
        font_size_pt=10, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT,
    )
    # columns B..E — money
    for col_idx, val in enumerate((b, c, d, e), start=1):
        write_cell(
            row.cells[col_idx], fmt_money(val),
            font_size_pt=10, money=True,
        )

    if is_gray:
        for cell in row.cells:
            set_cell_shading(cell, GRAY)

# --- Estimate row (row 15) ---------------------------------------------------
est_row = table.rows[14]
write_cell(
    est_row.cells[0], str(estimate[0]) if estimate[0] else 'Estimate No.',
    font_size_pt=9, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.LEFT,
)
for col_idx, val in enumerate(estimate[1:], start=1):
    write_cell(
        est_row.cells[col_idx],
        '' if val is None else str(val),
        font_size_pt=9, align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT,
    )

doc.save(OUT)
print('Saved', OUT)
